{{Quote|Grathan's people&mdash;took us prisoner for experiments. The scientists cut open our heads, put us in droids. Identification: Model OHK-99.|Tholver Shan|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''OHK-99''' was a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] built by [[Grathan]]'s [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] that were in fact [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] converted into [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Twenty soldiers under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarnova]], including [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Tholver Shan]], were captured by [[Lord Grathan's forces]] and converted to OHK-99 units.

{{GameDS}}
Later, an Imperial who encountered them in Grathan's laboratory decided to reprogram them to serve the Empire.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The light side choice is to deactivate the droids and put them out of their misery.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
